result.rationale: In refreshOAuthTokens, sync mode returns a raw fetch Response. In GoogleCalendarService, `const res = await refreshOAuthTokens(...); const token = res?.data;` — fetch Response has no `.data`, so token is undefined and `token.access_token` on the next line throws. The diff shows both pieces verbatim, so the crash mechanism is verifiable.

judged_text: In sync mode `res` is a fetch Response, which has no `.data` property, so `token` is undefined and `token.access_token` on the next line throws TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'access_token'). Every google-calendar token refresh crashes when credential sync is enabled; the surrounding catch turns it into a failed calendar operation, so google calendars never obtain a working access token under sync.
